## Latest articles
- [Yandex tests driverless container handling at an active yard](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-09/01-yandex-robotruck-container-yard.html) — The truck drove about 1.5 km through an operating yard and completed a container operation, with a remote operator and onboard observer still involved.
- [Physicl raises $10 million for targeted robot training data](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-09/02-physicl-robot-simulation.html) — Its Studio product recreates conditions in which a model fails, letting researchers train and evaluate changes in simulation.
- [Amazon brings Alexa for Shopping to text messages](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-09/03-alexa-shopping-text.html) — A small invited group in the US can text the shopping agent, with broader access planned over the coming weeks.
- [Meta adds prompt-built spaces to the Muse app](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/11/introducing-spaces-customize-muse-app/amp/) — Users describe a tracker, planner or project board and Muse builds a space inside the app. Meta says it is available wherever Muse is already offered.
- [Serve Robotics opens its physical AI tools to other robot builders](https://ir.serverobotics.com/news-releases/news-release-details/serve-robotics-launches-physical-ai-services-opening-technology) — Physical AI Services packages robot connectivity, data curation and data from Serve's own fleet. Serve names Bedrock Robotics among its launch customers.
- [Meta rolls out voice conversations with the Muse avatar in the US](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/11/introducing-muse-ai-voice-expressive-avatars/) — Muse Realtime Voice and Avatar bring live conversations to mobile, web and Mac. Support for AI glasses and the planned Charm device is still upcoming.
- [OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber for authorized security research](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-cyber/) — The model targets vulnerability discovery and validation. Initial API and Codex access is limited to selected approved Daybreak Red users.
- [Dropbox agrees to buy Tigris Data for about $350 million](https://investors.dropbox.com/node/14451/ixbrl-viewer) — The AI-oriented object storage acquisition has not closed. Dropbox expects completion in the fourth quarter and also announced DBX Agent Cloud.
- [Aina opens preorders for a screen-equipped AI control ring](https://www.aina.com/about) — The ring combines an OLED display, microphone, speaker and physical controller. The company expects first shipments in early 2027; it is a preorder, not a mass-market release.
